reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how soldiers move and engage in battles in Provincia. In our latest devtalk, we discuss the new mechanics that ensure soldiers maintain their formation and face the right direction during combat. No more teleporting units or chaotic movements! Learn more about how these changes enhance gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

discord.content: We've made some important updates to the movement mechanics in Provincia! Soldiers now maintain formation and only slide as they march, eliminating teleporting and chaotic movements. This change will significantly improve your battle experience. Learn more in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=discord&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: Revamping Movement Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to share our latest development updates! Our new movement mechanics ensure soldiers maintain their formation and face the correct direction during combat. This eliminates teleporting units and chaotic movements, making battles more strategic and immersive. Read all about it in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
